steps.hardClue: Build four elemental weapons from scattered parts, then upgrade each one.
steps.clue: Build and upgrade all four elemental staffs.

steps.hardClue: Place the four upgraded weapons in their matching pedestals.
steps.clue: Place the four upgraded staffs in their matching pedestals.

steps.hardClue: Press the red button inside a giant robot, then throw an explosive marker onto the stone seal.
steps.clue: Press the button inside a robot and throw a G-Strike onto the stone seal.

steps.hardClue: Deploy the drone into the opened seal and defeat the horde.
steps.clue: Deploy the Maxis Drone into the opened seal and defeat the Panzersoldat horde.

steps.hardClue: Shoot down the glowing plane, then kill the invisible pilot.
steps.clue: Shoot down the glowing plane, then kill its pilot while in Zombie Blood.

steps.hardClue: Punch twenty enemies underground to upgrade your melee attack.
steps.clue: Upgrade the One Inch Punch by punching glowing Templars beneath the excavation site.

steps.hardClue: Return the four upgraded weapons to their original realm and collect one hundred zombie souls.
steps.clue: Return all four staffs to the Crazy Place and collect one hundred zombie souls.

steps.hardClue: Deploy the drone beneath the central portal.
steps.clue: Deploy the Maxis Drone beneath the central portal to free Samantha.
